jordan: CI on main is red after the latest serialization change — snapshot diffs for a couple of golden tests. failing jobs: tests/golden/test_prompt_roundtrip.py::test_roundtrip, tests/golden/test_prompt_spacing.py::test_spacing. CI run: https://ci.redwood.example/runs/12345. Can someone take a quick look or rerun/bisect? :eyes:
ci-bot: Build 12345 job 4567 failed. Rerun queued. Manual rerun: https://ci.redwood.example/runs/12345/retry or cli: `ci re-run 12345 --job=4567`
maria: I reproduced this locally after PR 4f2a1c8 — serializer now escapes trailing newlines differently. To repro quickly locally:
```
# run only the failing tests
pytest tests/golden/test_prompt_roundtrip.py::test_roundtrip -q -s
pytest tests/golden/test_prompt_spacing.py::test_spacing -q -s
# try updating snapshots to see if change is intended
UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=1 pytest tests/golden/test_prompt_roundtrip.py::test_roundtrip
```
leo: If it's reproducible, bisect helps find the exact commit. Example:
```
git fetch origin && git checkout main
# mark a known-good SHA (before the serializer change) and bad (HEAD)
git bisect start HEAD 4f2a1c8
git bisect run pytest -q tests/golden/test_prompt_roundtrip.py::test_roundtrip
```
Note: `git bisect run` expects non-zero exit on fail; wrap the test if needed to return proper codes.
devops-sam: I reran the failing job twice on CI — one pass, one fail. Logs: https://ci.redwood.example/runs/12345/logs/4567. Diff shows token escaping differences in snapshot content ("\n" vs actual newline). Seems like a deterministic change, not pure flake.
jordan: Good catch. Two possibilities: this was an intentional serializer improvement (we should update snapshots) or a regression causing nondeterministic outputs. maria, would you prefer to open a PR updating the snapshots + changelog, or add a compat header in the serializer? :thinking_face:
maria: I'll open a PR to add a small compatibility header (serial_version) to dumps and update affected snapshots in a dedicated commit. I'll include a changelog note and a short migration note in the tests. Drafting now, cc @leo for review. :thumbsup:
leo: I think we should avoid mass snapshot churn. Instead add a normalizer in the snapshot comparator that tolerates newline-escape normalization (and maybe strip trailing whitespace). I'll add a unit to cover the normalization so future changes don't regress.
jordan: Sounds good — maria will own the serializer shim + snapshot updates, leo will add the comparator normalization. If anyone else hits this, rerun CI twice, attach the failing job log, and include `git bisect` results if available.
ci-bot: Cross-posting to flaky-tests dashboard: created issue #987 for "snapshot escape drift" (https://flaky.redwood.example/issues/987) — add any logs there.
